tags.bug: Fixed an issue where aiming could not be immediately performed after being hit, requiring the aim button to be pressed again.
Fixed a problem where the screen jumps to other places at the start of transitions.
Fixed an issue where the shotgun sometimes dealt damage but did not interact with objects.
Fixed some settings that could not be saved.
Fixed incorrect dialogue triggering on 3/F.
Fixed corrupted text in Korean.

tags.feature: Added new BF documents.
BF Boss will now automatically SAVE after being defeated.
Language will no longer update every time when applying settings.
Updated rooftop transition animations and voiceovers.
Updated the leaving school transition animations and voiceovers.

tags.balance_change: Changed shotgun hit distance for closer range hits.
Updated item extraction so it won't extract all nearby items at once.
Shotgun can now trigger interactions at closer distances.

tags.feature: Added shortcut key for automatic weapon extraction.
Added ability to throw grenades consecutively.
Added automatic playback function during story scenes.

tags.balance_change: Reduced attack power of spinning kick.

tags.feature: Added perspective direction to the mini-map.
Added option to customize aim assist.

tags.balance_change: Modified hand grid icons and appearance.

tags.feature: Updated UI.

tags.bug: Fixed the issue where long-pressing the cancel button sometimes speeds up the game.
Fixed the problem where map colors were not displayed correctly in hard mode.
Fixed the issue where the playground lighting dims during rainy weather.
Fixed errors in the display of certain items.
Fixed missing subtitles in the 2F room.
Fixed the inability to switch weapons using hotkeys after loading a save.
Fixed the automatic respawn of flying insects.
Fixed errors in the display of certain maps.
Fixed damage detection after an exploding egg is burned.
Improved zombie death animations for smoother movements.
Fixed missing wall colors on certain floors of the school.

tags.feature: Added volume settings for characters.
Added Korean and German language options.
Displayed selected difficulty level when saving.
Added an image system within documents.

tags.balance_change: Reduced SP stamina when using push actions.

tags.feature: Enabled simultaneous use of push actions and knife.
Added the ability to sprint using the B key.
Added trajectory lines for throwable objects.
Allowed mouse usage when viewing documents.
Added surprise sound effects for headshots.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.5.2v
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048665/b35979c63463d3c034932faf099f1a01984245bf.png"][/img][/p][h1][b]Hotfix 1.5.2v[/b][/h1][p]
[b]Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed issue where sometimes no blood would appear.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where monsters would sometimes stand back up (invincible) after death.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where moving items back to their original slot would duplicate them.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where raising the gun was impossible after being attacked.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Optimizations:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Adjusted character backlighting.[/p][/*][*][p]UI improvements.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]New/Changes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Updated weapon switching sound effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated gunshot effects on monsters.[/p][/*][*][p]Added immobilization effect for grenade explosions.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated scene transitions to no longer require button inputs.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased crawling speed.[/p][/*][*][p]Prevented dodging from bypassing explosions.[/p][/*][*][p]Added three new languages (French, Spanish, Russian).[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Known Issues:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Zombie animation sometimes does not sync when being bitten.[/p][/*][/list]

tags.bug: Fixed issue where sometimes no blood would appear.
Fixed issue where monsters would sometimes stand back up (invincible) after death.
Fixed issue where moving items back to their original slot would duplicate them.
Fixed issue where raising the gun was impossible after being attacked.
Zombie animation sometimes does not sync when being bitten.

tags.feature: Added immobilization effect for grenade explosions.
Updated scene transitions to no longer require button inputs.
Added three new languages (French, Spanish, Russian).
